page_title: TOR 1-1 ROM | Torino v AS Roma 24/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Marco Guida is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) meets a cross inside the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
90+5' Ivan Ilic (Torino) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
90+5' Yann Karamoh (Torino) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Torino have a corner.
90+3' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
87' Jose Mourinho has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Andrea Belotti (AS Roma) replacing Leonardo Spinazzola.
85' 1 - 1 Duvan Zapata (Torino) celebrates a beautiful goal. He wins the ball inside the box from the free kick and plants a header inside the left post. 1:1.
85' Torino will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
85' It will be a substitution. Pietro Pellegri (Torino) is ready to enter the pitch as Raoul Bellanova walks off.
84' A yellow card for a tackle by Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma). Marco Guida doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
82' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
82' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
80' Diego Llorente (AS Roma) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
79' Diego Llorente (AS Roma) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
76' Ivan Juric has decided to substitute Adrien Tameze and he is replaced by Yann Karamoh (Torino).
76' It's time for a substitution. Antonio Sanabria (Torino) comes on in place of Demba Seck.
75' Torino couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Rui Patricio (AS Roma) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
72' Marco Guida blows his whistle as Raoul Bellanova (Torino) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
72' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
70' Stephan El Shaarawy goes off the pitch and Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) comes on.
68' 0 - 1 Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the bottom right corner.
67' Demba Seck (Torino) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
66' Demba Seck (Torino) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post.
66' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
64' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) controls a nice lofted pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but his attempt is neither hard nor precise, so Vanja Milinkovic-Savic stops it easily.
63' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
61' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Torino, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
60' Today's referee Marco Guida rightly decides to book Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) for his harsh tackle.
58' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) squanders a golden opportunity after striking the ball onto the post of the goal!
58' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
56' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
55' That's the end of the game for Nemanja Radonjic, who is replaced by Nikola Vlasic (Torino).
55' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
53' Golden chance! Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.
52' Demba Seck (Torino) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches past the left post. He should have scored!
51' Duvan Zapata (Torino) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Rui Patricio sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner.
50' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) fires the ball on goal, but his attempt goes well wide of the left post.
49' The ball is out of play and Torino manage to earn a corner.
48' A long ball forward to Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) is intercepted.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Marco Guida has a clear sight and sees a foul from Demba Seck (Torino).
41' Duvan Zapata (Torino) rises above the defence to meet a cross from the corner. His timing is good, but he directs his header just a few inches wide of the left post.
41' Ivan Ilic (Torino) is about to take a corner kick.
41' Duvan Zapata (Torino) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
37' Demba Seck (Torino) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
36' The game is interrupted now, Demba Seck (Torino) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
35' Nemanja Radonjic (Torino) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Rui Patricio stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
33' Diego Llorente (AS Roma) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Marco Guida blows for a foul.
31' Surely that's handball by one of the Torino players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
30' Ricardo Rodriguez (Torino) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
30' The resulting corner from Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is cleared.
29' Duvan Zapata (Torino) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
28' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
26' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Torino comes to nothing.
25' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
24' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Raoul Bellanova (Torino), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
23' Nemanja Radonjic (Torino) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
22' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
21' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
18' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
14' AS Roma seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
12' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
9' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot on goal, but the ball curls just wide of the right post.
7' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) makes a rough challenge and Marco Guida blows his whistle for a foul.
5' A brilliant cross into the box finds Duvan Zapata (Torino), who directs his header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper shows all his agility and makes an astonishing save.

2' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Torino force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
1' The first half has just begun.
AS Roma will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Marco Guida.
